purpose: Give the customer the tools and building blocks to design, test, compare and refine their own trading strategy.
selection_policy: The customer chooses the strategy, indicators, parameters and rules. Leverage provides research tools and evidence; it does not automatically declare a winning strategy.

customer_tools.name: Interactive Chart
customer_tools.purpose: Inspect price, overlays, indicators and signals.

customer_tools.name: Strategy Builder
customer_tools.purpose: Combine conditions into customer-defined entry, exit and filter rules.

customer_tools.name: Parameter Lab
customer_tools.purpose: Compare parameter values without silently selecting a winner.

customer_tools.name: Backtester
customer_tools.purpose: Test customer-defined rules with fees and slippage.

customer_tools.name: Out-of-Sample Test
customer_tools.purpose: Reserve unseen data to challenge a strategy after design.

customer_tools.name: Walk-Forward Analysis
customer_tools.purpose: Repeat train/test windows to test stability over time.

customer_tools.name: Parameter Sensitivity
customer_tools.purpose: See whether performance collapses when parameters move slightly.

customer_tools.name: Risk & Position Sizing
customer_tools.purpose: Calculate position size, stop distance, risk per trade and exposure.

customer_tools.name: Strategy Comparison
customer_tools.purpose: Compare customer-created strategies using consistent metrics.

customer_tools.name: Paper Trading
customer_tools.purpose: Run a selected customer strategy without real capital.

customer_tools.name: Research Export
customer_tools.purpose: Export charts, metrics, trades and configurations.

customer_flow: Customer decides whether to use it
automation_boundary: Automation may calculate, visualize, compare and validate. It must not silently select or market a strategy as the best strategy for the customer.
